data.name: Humair
data.gender_notes: Humair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Humair is an Arabic name that symbolizes strength and courage, reminiscent of a lion's bravery. It is a powerful and regal name that evokes a sense of fearlessness and confidence. The name Humair carries the meaning “Lion-like” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humair usually hope their child will grow to embody lion-like and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Humair is associated with the qualities of a lion, which is considered a noble and majestic creature in the Quran.
data.etymology: Humair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion-like.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humair total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Humair is also associated with the qualities of courage, determination, and strength, which are highly valued in Islamic culture.
